status: PREPARED ONLY - user review before any ANSYS invocation
geometry: Saved upper-skin station data; cubic interpolation chordwise, linear spanwise; uniform maximum upper-skin layup. Controlled benchmark, not exact variable-thickness wing reproduction.
normal: inward; outer surface is shell BOT

solid.formulation: SOLID186 homogeneous per material volume; KEYOPT(2)=1 full integration, KEYOPT(3)=0

loads.method: Q1 field frozen on 16x16 grid from saved aerodynamic panel forces / projected panel area; consistent 3x3 Gauss integration, +global Z, not follower pressure
loads.quadratic_negative_nodal_force_note: Consistent Q8 face loading can give negative corner nodal weights; the underlying traction is positive and distributed.

boundary_transfer: Reference translation + rotation cross inward thickness offset on all solid cut faces; corresponding six DOFs on shell edges, from saved 3/3/3 full wing. No constraints on interior top/bottom faces.
comparison_zone: Exclude a proposed 2*total-thickness distance from artificial cut boundaries; evaluate interior motion/stresses and total boundary reactions, not imposed-boundary displacement agreement.
limitations: Uniform thick layup and smoothed curvature are explicit benchmark idealizations.
Inherited cut motion comes from the original variable-thickness whole-wing solution.
No contact, joint strength, buckling or sizing validation.
Mapped mesh checks are Python geometric checks; ANSYS element checks await a later authorized run.
